TAX PARCEL ID: New York, New York PP、 Block 394 Lots 5 and 67 RECORD&RETURN TO: Augspach Law PLLC 551Fifth Avenue,Suite 1620 New York,NewYork 10176 TITLE NO: Zoning Lot Development Agreement THIS ZoNING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made as of this 11th day of October, 2017, by and between ToMPKINs 183 LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at c/o Augspach Law PLLC, 551 Fifth Avenue, Suite 1620,New York, New York 10176 ("Tompkins 183"), and NEw YoRK GARDEN TRUST, INC., a New York Not-for-Profit corporation, having an office c/o New York Restoration Project, 1290 Avenue of the Americas, New York, New York 10012 ("Garden Trust") (collectively, the "Parties" and each a "Party"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAs the Parties are the owners of certain land and improvements thereon located in the City and State of NewYork, County of NewYork and bearing the following tax map designations: Owner Property Tax Map Designation TOMPKINS183 183 Avenue B New York County,Block 394,Lot 5 ("Purchaser's Property") GARDEN TRUST 603 East 11h Street New York County,Block 394,Lot 67 ("NYGT's Property") Which lots are jointlymoreparticularly described as follows: SEEATTACHEDSCHEDULEA-LEGALDESCRIPTION (collectively, the"Property"or "Combined Zoning Lot"); WHEREAs Tompkins 183 desires to construct a new building (the "New Purchaser Building") which will be located on Purchaser's Property in excess of the bulk presently permitted to be constructed on the Purchaser's Property under the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined), and accordingly, Tompkins 183 desires to acquire and utilize in the New Purchaser Building, and 897434.02A-NYCSR05A -MSW

(hereinafter defined) and have such Transferred Development Rights allocated to the Purchaser's Property in accordance with this Agreement; WHEREAs the Parties desire to create one zoning lot consisting of the aforementioned two tax Trust; WHEREAs the two tax lots are located within the block and adjoin each other by 10 feet or more; WHEREAs all Parties in Interest (hereinafter defined) to the creation of a single Zoning Lot (hereinafter defined), as shown in that certain Zoning Lot Certification of Elliot Hurwitz, as agent of Chicago Title Insurance Company, and simultaneously submitted for recording herewith, have consented to this Agreement or waived their right to do so; and WHEREAs the Parties have made a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date herewith (the "Declaration") to declare the Property a single zoning lot, which Declaration is simultaneously being submitted for recording herewith. Now, THEREFORE, in consideration of ten dollars ($10.00), other valuable consideration and the foregoing recitals, the Parties, intending to bind themselves, the Property, and all current and future Parties in Interest to the Property, do hereby declare: I. Definitions.As used herein: A. "Agreement" shall have the meaning set forth in the Preamble. or instruments for all ·required variances, authorizations, and other permits and certificates, and the processing thereof by the Department of Buildings of the City , the New York City Planning Commission, the New York City Department of City Planning, the New York City Board of Standards and Appeals, the Department of Housing, Preservation and Development or the New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission, or any other agency of the City and (i) any applications made subsequent to a downzoning seeking to increase the Floor Area or Floor Area Ratio attributable to the Combined Zoning Lot to the amount available as of the date hereof or to modify or rescind any limitations or restrictions on development more restrictive than those in effect as of the date hereof. C. "Bonus Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean any bonus floor area and other development rights attributed to the Combined Zoning Lot which may be available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon (i) through the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on or off the Combined Zoning Lot, and (i) by way of transfer from a zoning lot that is not included in the Combined Zoning Lot, including bonus floor area generated as-of-right or by special permit, authorization or certification, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Zoning Resolution. 2 897434.02A-NYCSR05A-MSW
